'''Lee Quick''' is a voice actress for the English dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is also credited as '''Heather Quick''' or '''Heather Lee'''.

==Biography==
Quick was born on August 30, 1968, in Jefferson County, Kentucky. During the 1990s and 2000s, she had a career as a voice actress. Though she got few roles overall, her best-known one was as [[Officer Jenny]] from the [[S01|first season]] to the [[S07|seventh season]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. [[Jamie Davyous Owens]] took over the role in the following season, and Quick has not had any major roles since. She currently resides in New York City, New York.
